text.en: Blocking in experimental design is the same thing as randomization, just a different word for it -- in reality, blocking groups similar experimental units together BEFORE randomizing treatment assignment within each group, which removes a known source of variability from the background noise a test has to see through -- a distinct technique from randomization itself, which the blocked design still uses within each block.
text.et: Plokkimine katse planeerimises on sama asi mis randomiseerimine, lihtsalt teine sõna selle jaoks -- tegelikult rühmitab plokkimine sarnased katseüksused kokku ENNE ravi määramise randomiseerimist igas rühmas, mis eemaldab teadaoleva varieeruvuse allika taustamürast, mida test peab läbi nägema -- eristuv tehnika randomiseerimisest endast, mida plokitud disain siiski igas plokis kasutab.
